results.title: Burundi: A fashion show, made out of recycled waste
results.content: The "Kamenge Drop" in northern Bujumbura celebrates local youths' talent - and showcases innovative ways of using recycled waste to create something new and aesthetic.

results.title: Mexico: spectacular Catrina parade brings the dead to life
results.content: Skeleton faces, extravagant headdresses and dazzling costumes transformed Mexico City's streets into a colourful spectacle. The annual Catrinas Parade celebrates the country's Day of the Dead traditions.

results.title: Suspect in Paris shooting moved to police psychiatric unit
results.content: French authorities have transferred to a psychiatric unit a man suspected of a gun attack in the Paris suburbs that killed one person and wounded five, prosecutors said Sunday. The 39-year-old man, identified as Kevin T., is reportedly suffering from schizophrenia.

results.title: US: Nicki Minaj endorses Trump at Michigan Republican rally
results.content: Nicki Minaj joined Donald Trump at a Republican rally in Michigan, declaring her support for the president. The event also saw Trump renew his attacks on Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed.

results.title: Brazil's Lula clinches re-election, Bolsonaro calls to annul vote
results.content: Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva pulled off a dramatic comeback on Sunday to clinch re-election to a fourth non-consecutive term. The leftist icon won just under 52 percent of the vote, according to official results. His rival, Flavio Bolsonaro got 48.2 percent.

results.title: Brazil: Thousands flood streets to celebrate Lula's election victory
results.content: Tears, hugs and dancing filled the streets of Brazil after Lula narrowly defeated Flávio Bolsonaro. Thousands celebrated in Rio and São Paulo as the president secured another four years in office.

results.title: 'National emergency': 24 dead in Kenya bus crash near site of previous fatal accident
results.content: A bus collided with a truck on Kenya's main highway on Sunday, killing at least 24 people, police said. The crash came three weeks after 17 people died in another accident along the same highway linking the capital, Nairobi, with the coastal city of Mombasa.

results.title: Ebola: Uganda introduces 21-day quarantine for people entering from DRC
results.content: Travellers entering Uganda after visiting DR Congo will face a 21-day quarantine, the country's health minister announced on Sunday. The new screening measures come after Nigeria reported its first case of the virus in a woman returning from Uganda. Kampala insists the country remains Ebola-free.

results.title: Serbia: crowds celebrate in Belgrade after Vučić admits defeat
results.content: Crowds celebrated in Belgrade after President Aleksandar Vučić conceded defeat for his ruling party in Serbia's snap parliamentary election, following nearly two years of student-led demonstrations.

results.title: Brazil: long queues and river journeys mark decisive presidential vote
results.content: Brazilians headed to the polls on Sunday to choose between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. From canoe journeys in the Amazon to long queues in Rio and a Lula doll in Brasília, voters turned out for the presidential runoff.

results.title: Thousands of sheep take over Madrid's streets for Transhumance Festival
results.content: Over 1,400 sheep and goats took over Madrid's streets on Sunday, delighting spectators at the 33rd annual Transhumance Festival, which followed a different route this year to avoid a housing protest.

results.title: Gabon restores social media access after an eight-month ban
results.content: The media regulator pulled the plug on social networks in February blaming content posted online for stoking conflict and division in society.

results.title: Saudi Arabia's Riyadh airport partially resumes flights after Houthi attacks
results.content: The announcement comes after a two-week suspension of operations following strikes from Yemen's Houthis on the Saudi capital.

results.title: Iranian president blames United States for failure of interim peace deal
results.content: Masoud Pezeshkian emphasised, however, that a new attempt should be made to reach an agreement to end the war with the US and Israel.

results.title: Over 1,000 arrested in France after a day of mostly peaceful protests
results.content: There were clashes after night fall as police fired tear gas and water cannon to disperse protesters in a number of cities.

results.title: Red Cross trains staff as Kenya records its second death from Ebola
results.content: It says the fight to contain the virus does not end when a patient dies, saying the handling and burial of the body is just as important.

results.title: Niger imposes overnight fuel sales curfew amid nationwide shortage
results.content: Petrol stations are not allowed to sell fuel between nine at night and six in the morning to enable suppliers to restock them.

results.title: Nigeria's Tinubu defends policies as he launches re-election bid
results.content: Amid a cost-of-living crisis, President Bola Tinubu held his first campaign rally on Saturday as he hopes to win a second term in office in the January polls.

results.title: Haiti's ex-president Martelly registers as candidate for upcoming election
results.content: Haiti’s former president Michel Martelly is running for office again. He presented his candidacy on Friday for the December 13 elections - the country’s first in 10 years. Earlier this month, Haiti’s electoral council overturned a ban on candidates sanctioned by foreign countries.

results.title: HIV prevention jab offers hope in Uganda but doses are hard to find
results.content: An injectable HIV drug could save huge numbers of people from getting infected in Uganda. But shortages of lenacapavir mean that those who need it the most often can't get treated with a dose.

results.title: Two 'unauthorised' oil tankers struck in Strait of Hormuz, Iran says
results.content: Two 'unauthorised' supertankers hit naval mines near the Strait of Hormuz on Friday, according to Iran’s Revolutionary Guard navy. On Thursday, a ship transiting the strait was hit by an unknown projectile, the UK reported.

results.title: New Tumaini Ebola vaccine trial launches in Bunia as DRC struggles
results.content: A clinical trial for a new Ebola vaccine is getting underway in DR Congo’s Ituri province. The TUMAini trial will evaluate candidate vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain of the virus.

results.title: Brazil candidates make final campaign push ahead of presidential runoff
results.content: Almost 159 million Brazilians are eligible to vote Sunday in a closely contested presidential runoff between President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Sen. Flávio Bolsonaro, the son of former President Jair Bolsonaro.

results.title: CAR: Former hostages greeted by President Touadéra on return to Bangui
results.content: In Central African Republic, three hostages released this week after 10 months in captivity arrived in Bangui aboard a special UN flight. A local government official and two members of the National Election Authority, they were kidnapped in Bambouti in December, on the day of the general election.

results.title: Police dispel crowds with tear gas after 16-storey building collapses in Nairobi
results.content: Police used tear gas to dispel looters and crowds of onlookers after a high-rise building in Kenya’s capital Nairobi collapsed while under construction.

results.title: Hungary: 70 years after Soviet crackdown, leaders honour uprising victims
results.content: Seventy years after Hungary's 1956 uprising against Soviet rule, Prime Minister Péter Magyar paid tribute to its victims as Ursula von der Leyen highlighted the importance of freedom and democracy.

results.title: Johannesburg men run in purple briefs to raise prostate cancer awareness
results.content: A sea of purple briefs takes over Johannesburg. Men hit the streets on Friday for the Hollard Daredevil Run, raising awareness about prostate cancer, now the most commonly diagnosed cancer in South Africa.

results.title: Portugal’s last circus elephant begins a new life at wildlife sanctuary
results.content: A new beginning for Julie, Portugal’s last circus elephant, as she settles into life at a wildlife sanctuary in Alentejo, southern Portugal.

results.title: Benin earns four nominations at 2026 Africa Tourism Awards
results.content: Benin has been nominated in four categories at the 2026 Africa Tourism Awards, putting the West African nation in the spotlight for its cultural heritage and tourism appeal.

results.title: Deforestation threatens fish stocks and livelihoods in Central African Republic
results.content: Experts say deforestation is causing lower water levels on the river, making it muddier and reducing its oxygen content, which makes it more difficult for fish to breed.
